race.comment: Sale Cup time. TEN COMMANDMENTS (5) is a tricky one. Pegged as a wet tracker, he bolted in on firm ground at Ballarat two back then struggled on heavy at Flemington as favourite. Back up to a mile should suit much better now. Should be winning. FREEDOM RALLY (2) can mix form and is off a freshen but has the ability and can run well. EL ROCKO (8) should be much better third up to a mile and any rain really helps him. MAKDANE (9) turned in a moderate performance at his last start but has been freshened for this and can give a sight. HAARACAINE (11) was successful at his latest appearance over 1600m at Ballarat, scoring by a head. Top 4 chance.
